title: Gamesforum Digest 2026-08-14
summary: Webstore revenue is exploding across casino and midcore genres, Pokémon Go's 10th anniversary drove a historic monthly spike, and Love and Deepspace collapsed after a content backlash - underscoring both the upside of DTC channels and the fragility of live-service reputation management.
